context: An elderly couple talks softly about an ordinary day
purpose: Teach: ただただ/なんらかの/あがり/かえる/愉快/平凡/悪口/手足

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今日も平凡な一日だったね。
lines.en: Today was just an ordinary day, wasn't it.
lines.style: soft contented elderly male voice, slow pace

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、でもこうして静かに過ごせること、ただただありがたいわ。
lines.en: Yes, but being able to spend it quietly, I'm simply grateful.
lines.style: warm gentle grandmother tone, slow pace

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 階段をのぼると息があがりやすくなったよ。
lines.en: I get out of breath easily climbing the stairs now.
lines.style: soft elderly male voice, slightly tired

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 私も手足が冷えて、寒い日はつらいの。
lines.en: My hands and feet get cold too, chilly days are hard.
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, sympathetic and tender

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それでも誰かの悪口を言わずに暮らせるのは、なんらかの形で幸せなんだろうね。
lines.en: Still, living without speaking ill of anyone is happiness in some form.
lines.style: reflective elderly male voice, gentle and warm

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当にね。あなたといると、なんだか愉快な気持ちになるのよ。
lines.en: Really. When I'm with you, I somehow feel cheerful inside.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, smiling softly throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: さて、気分をかえるために、お茶でも入れなおそうか。
lines.en: Well then, let's change the mood and brew some fresh tea.
lines.style: warm elderly male voice, content and unhurried

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ありがとう。あなたが入れてくれるお茶が一番好きよ。
lines.en: Thank you. The tea you make is my very favorite.
lines.style: soft loving grandmother tone, deeply affectionate
